x-sdk-skills.description: Antdv Next X SDK core skill package, including complete features such as useXChat, XRequest, and custom Provider
x-sdk-skills.descriptionZh: Antdv Next X SDK 核心技能包，包含 useXChat、XRequest 和自定义 Provider 等完整功能

skills.name: use-x-chat
skills.desc: Use when building Vue chat state with useXChat, including custom Provider integration, message management, error handling, and multi-conversation management.
skills.descZh: 使用 useXChat 构建 Vue 聊天状态时使用，覆盖自定义 Provider 集成、消息管理、错误处理和多会话管理。

skills.name: x-card
skills.desc: Use when rendering A2UI dynamic cards with @antdv-next/x-card — covers XCardBox, XCardCard, A2UI v0.8/v0.9 commands, data binding, action events, component catalogs, and custom component contracts.
skills.descZh: 使用 @antdv-next/x-card 渲染 A2UI 动态卡片时使用，覆盖 XCardBox、XCardCard、A2UI v0.8/v0.9 指令、数据绑定、动作事件、组件目录以及自定义组件契约。

skills.name: x-chat-provider
skills.desc: Focus on implementing custom Chat Provider, helping to adapt any streaming interface to Antdv Next X standard format
skills.descZh: 专注于自定义 Chat Provider 的实现，帮助将任意流式接口适配为 Antdv Next X 标准格式

skills.name: x-request
skills.desc: Focus on explaining the practical configuration and usage of XRequest, providing accurate configuration instructions based on official documentation
skills.descZh: 专注讲解 XRequest 的实际配置和使用，基于官方文档提供准确的配置说明

x-components.description: Antdv Next X UI component skill package, covering chat UI components such as Bubble, Sender, Conversations, ThoughtChain, Actions, and more
x-components.descriptionZh: Antdv Next X UI 组件技能包，覆盖 Bubble、Sender、Conversations、ThoughtChain、Actions 等对话界面组件

skills.name: x-components
skills.desc: Use when building AI chat UIs with @antdv-next/x components — covers Bubble, BubbleList, Sender, Conversations, Prompts, ThoughtChain, Actions, Welcome, Attachments, Sources, Suggestion, Think, FileCard, CodeHighlighter, Mermaid, Folder, XProvider, and Notification.
skills.descZh: 使用 @antdv-next/x 构建 AI 对话界面时使用，覆盖 Bubble、BubbleList、Sender、Conversations、Prompts、ThoughtChain、Actions、Welcome、Attachments、Sources、Suggestion、Think、FileCard、CodeHighlighter、Mermaid、Folder、XProvider 和 Notification。

x-markdown.description: Antdv Next X Markdown rendering skill package, providing rich text rendering and chat enhancement features
x-markdown.descriptionZh: Antdv Next X Markdown 渲染技能包，提供富文本渲染和对话增强功能

skills.name: x-markdown
skills.desc: Use when building or reviewing Markdown rendering with @antdv-next/x-markdown, including streaming Markdown, custom component mapping, plugins, themes, and chat-oriented rich content.
skills.descZh: 当任务涉及 @antdv-next/x-markdown 的 Markdown 渲染、流式输出、自定义组件映射、插件、主题或聊天富内容展示时使用。
